description: JavaScript functions for TinyMCE advlink plugin popup, including URL handling, form initialization, link attribute management, and dynamic HTML generation.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Initializes TinyMCE window arguments and loads external link list URL script if specified.

methods.name: changeClass
methods.description: Updates the 'classes' form field based on selected class list.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the advlink popup, populates form fields, and sets up link editing or insertion.

methods.name: checkPrefix
methods.description: Pre-fixes email and URL inputs with 'mailto:' or 'http://' if confirmed by user.

methods.name: setFormValue
methods.description: Sets a form field's value.

methods.name: convertURL
methods.description: Converts URLs using a callback function defined in TinyMCE settings.

methods.name: parseWindowOpen
methods.description: Parses onclick attribute for window.open configurations and populates form fields.

methods.name: parseFunction
methods.description: Placeholder for parsing other onclick functions.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value from a options object.

methods.name: setPopupControlsDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables popup control form fields.

methods.name: parseLink
methods.description: Parses a link string to extract function name and parameters based on templates.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Parses options string into key-value pairs.

methods.name: buildOnClick
methods.description: Constructs the onclick attribute for window.open based on form inputs.

methods.name: setAttrib
methods.description: Sets or removes an attribute on an element.

methods.name: getAnchorListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown list of anchor names in the editor.

methods.name: insertAction
methods.description: Creates or updates a link element in the editor with form data.

methods.name: setAllAttribs
methods.description: Sets all relevant attributes on a link element based on form inputs.

methods.name: getSelectValue
methods.description: Retrieves the selected value from a select element.

methods.name: getLinkListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown list of links.

methods.name: getTargetListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown list of link target options.
